ABOUT MYPOKEPANION

Six tabs fewer.

MyPokePanion grew out of one very concrete annoyance and became a toolkit that bundles everything you actually need while playing.

Why this site exists

Whenever I played a Nuzlocke myself, I had five or six tabs open at all times: a wiki for encounters, one for moves, a type chart, a damage calculator, a route list, a team overview. Every single decision in the run meant jumping between tabs. MyPokePanion is the answer: one place that unites exactly this information: fast, beautiful, in German and English.

Built for players

A full dex with sprite museum and descriptions, region maps with encounter tables and items, a Nuzlocke tracker with soul-link co-op, a team builder with legality checks and Showdown export, a versus lab for matchups, and an item lexicon. All tools I wished for as a player myself.

A hobby project

This site is not a company product but a passion project I keep developing in my free time. New features land regularly, and honestly, the best part is feedback from real players.

Found a bug or have an idea that would make the tool better? That helps me more than anything. Tell me.
